name: Odunayo Abraham
title: DevOps Engineer & Software Developer
tagline: Bridging low-level systems, high-performance backends, and modern web architecture.
about:
Software engineer and DevOps specialist who builds, deploys and operates the systems I write.

I shipped custom Android OS builds (StatiXOS, helluvaOS), built polyglot microservices in Rust and Java, and run a live platform on Azure behind GitHub Actions CI/CD, with Prometheus and Grafana alerting and verified backups. This site's services run on Google Cloud Run. I also built a K3s GitOps lab with Argo CD, SLO burn-rate alerts and a measured git-revert rollback.

highlights.label: Systems & OS
highlights.detail: Custom AOSP ROMs, Linux kernel workflows

highlights.label: Cloud & DevOps
highlights.detail: Docker, Kubernetes (K3s), Argo CD, Cloud Run, GitHub Actions CI/CD

highlights.label: Backend
highlights.detail: Rust (Axum), Java (Spring Boot), rate limiting, OAuth

experience.description: Run a live multi-service platform on an Azure VM: GitHub Actions CI/CD with Trivy scans, Grafana alerting to Discord, encrypted nightly backups with verified restores, and written incident reviews (Jan 2026 – present).
Engineered cross-platform solutions utilizing Flutter and Rust.
Official device maintainer for the Pixel 3 and 3 XL: device trees, kernels, monthly AOSP security patches and OTA releases, with the official release threads published on XDA.
Administered the computer lab and its network, and taught TCP/IP, subnetting, routing and DNS to 50+ students (June 2025 – June 2026).

projects.title: Flutter & Rust Octernship
projects.description: Cross-platform application using a native Flutter UI with a Rust FFI backend core, demonstrating high-performance interop across mobile platforms.

projects.title: DevOps Control Center
projects.description: Self-hosted infrastructure dashboard with live container and deployment management, real-time telemetry and JWT-secured role-based access. Originally on a K3s cluster, migrated to Docker Compose behind Caddy after documenting the cost and operational trade-offs in an ADR.

projects.title: K3s GitOps Lab
projects.description: Single-node Kubernetes lab on an 8 GB Linode VM where everything deploys through Argo CD from git, with drift correction. A 99% SLO with multi-window burn-rate alerts tested in CI, a planned bad release that the alerts caught and a git revert rolled back, written up with measured times, and Terraform describing the hand-built VM. Synthetic traffic only.

projects.title: Polyglot Microservice Portfolio
projects.description: Production monorepo serving this site: a Leptos (Rust/WebAssembly) frontend backed by live Rust (Axum) and Spring Boot APIs, each deployed to Google Cloud Run by GitHub Actions CI/CD with Trivy scanning.

projects.title: WSL Traffic Monitor
projects.description: Lightweight native Windows desktop application for real-time WSL2 network traffic monitoring with a glanceable floating overlay UI, redb history persistence, and Win32 IP Helper API adapter discovery.

projects.title: StatiXOS — Pixel 3 / 3 XL
projects.description: Official Android 13 builds I maintained for blueline and crosshatch: device trees, kernel sources, monthly AOSP security patch merges and OTA releases. ~1,600 downloads, forked by another ROM project, and covered by third-party install guides.
